opendev.org.do: Gitea code browser serves an Anubis bot challenge ("Making sure you're not a bot!"). Never webfetch. Read code from the local clone (ghq list -p <repo>, else ghq get https://opendev.org/<owner>/<repo>), or from raw.githubusercontent.com/openstack/<repo>/<ref>/<path>. docs.openstack.org and review.opendev.org are separate hosts and work.

review.opendev.org.do: Use the Gerrit REST API, not the web UI: /changes/?q=<query>, /changes/<change-id>/detail, /changes/<change-id>/revisions/current/patch (base64 body). JSON responses start with )]}' which must be stripped before parsing. For a full review, prefer git review -d <number> in the local clone.
